rows.definition: The model callback signature and same-named Session constructor for normalizing one full-profile V4.1 collapsed hidden row. The constructor binds the existing session-owned RMSNorm operation to the layer attn_norm.weight and HiddenSize, or returns nil when that operation is unavailable.
rows.distinction: This is the callable operation and its session-bound construction. v41AttentionInputNormWithDevice owns the BF16 input/output boundary; attentionNorm stores the resulting callback in forward state.

rows.definition: The Model adapter used at V4.1 attention-input normalization sites. A selected callback receives an owned BF16-rounded hidden row and its result is checked, copied and BF16-rounded for publication. A nil callback preserves the existing host normalization; a selected callback error is returned without host retry.
rows.distinction: This is the per-invocation BF16 and error boundary around normalization. v41AttentionInputNormFunc defines and binds the operation, while attentionNorm retains that operation across forward execution.

rows.definition: The optional v41ForwardState field retaining the session-bound attention-input normalization callback across grouped, incremental and resident-stream forward execution. Scratch reuse clears the field and session state restoration rebinds it to the target session owner.
rows.distinction: This is forward-state storage for the selected operation. v41AttentionInputNormFunc constructs the callable; v41AttentionInputNormWithDevice applies its dtype, ownership and failure contract to each input row. The similarly named attentionNorms method returns a bundle of normalization weights and biases; this field stores an executable callback.
